# Coverage waiver inventory for guard-core-go.
#
# Every entry is a defensive statement that is unreachable as written. The
# gate treats these statements as satisfied and fails on any uncovered
# statement NOT listed here. Genuine tests are preferred over waivers: the
# twin sweep (guardcore/coverage_twin_sweep_test.go and its integration
# half) covers every remaining reachable statement with real inputs.
#
# Rebaselined after the feature-port waves (event bus, dynamic rules,
# headers cache, cloud/geo, pattern ledger, PerformanceMonitor) shifted
# line numbers and superseded the PR #39 audit coordinates (whose audit
# also shrank itself: behavior.go 345, ratelimit.go 340 and redis.go 200
# turned out testable and are covered by real tests, not listed here).
# Proofs are restated against the current sources with the go 1.27
# statement attribution CI uses.
#
# Format: <file>:<startLine> per line; comments (#) and blank lines ignored.

# base64decode.go
# 54: findAllStrings stale-match guard. regexp2's FindStringMatchStartingAt
#     never reports a match whose Index precedes the requested start, so
#     m.Index < pos cannot hold.
# 60: zero-advance guard. Every b64 RE on this path (b64SubFloorRE and
#     friends) requires at least one character, so m.Length > 0 and
#     next = m.Index + m.Length > pos always; the fallback is defensive.
# 236, 297: ReplaceFunc error returns. A compiled regexp2 RE cannot error
#     during replace; the err != nil branches are defensive hygiene.
# 363: zero-advance guard. shortBase64TokenRE is {4,}, so m.Length >= 4 and
#     pos = m.Index + m.Length > m.Index always.
guardcore/base64decode.go:54
guardcore/base64decode.go:60
guardcore/base64decode.go:236
guardcore/base64decode.go:297
guardcore/base64decode.go:363

# bodyscan.go
# 398: parseHeaderParams empty-split guard. splitHeaderParams appends a
#     trailing piece unconditionally, so len(pieces) >= 1 always.
guardcore/bodyscan.go:398

# checks_custom.go
# 132, 142: customRequestCheckFunctionName anonymous fallbacks. The check
#     only runs with a non-nil hook, runtime.FuncForPC over a non-nil func
#     value's PC always names a real symbol, and Go symbol names never end
#     in '.' after the final '/' segment, so the stripped name is never
#     empty.
guardcore/checks_custom.go:132
guardcore/checks_custom.go:142

# composition.go
# 107, 108: Cloud.InitializeRedis failure branch. InitializeRedis errors
#     only on a nil handler, and e.Redis is non-nil after the successful
#     Initialize above; RefreshAsync returns nil on every path.
# 112: IPBanManager.InitializeRedis returns nil unconditionally.
guardcore/composition.go:107
guardcore/composition.go:108
guardcore/composition.go:112

# config.go
# 374: validateCORS error branch. It normalizes method/header case and
#     returns nil on every path.
guardcore/config.go:374

# dynamicrules.go
# 685, 690: writeAtomicFile write/close guards. A WriteString or Close on a
#     freshly created temp file fails only on ENOSPC/EIO-class conditions,
#     which cannot be induced in-process (per the in-code comment); the
#     cleanup contract (remove the temp, surface the error) is kept.
guardcore/dynamicrules.go:685
guardcore/dynamicrules.go:690

# encodings.go
# 38, 75, 86, 136, 222: escape-decode failure returns. hexEscapeRE,
#     unicodeEscapeRE, percentUEscapeRE, percentByteRunRE and
#     ldapHexEscapeStdRE capture hex digits only, so parseHex2 cannot fail
#     on the captured group.
# 187: utf8Len zero-length guard. utf8.DecodeRuneInString returns size 0
#     only for an empty remainder, and the caller guarantees a non-empty
#     slice (i < len(content)).
# 321: stripSQLComments monotonic guard. FindRunesMatchStartingAt never
#     reports matches behind the requested start or past the subject.
guardcore/encodings.go:38
guardcore/encodings.go:75
guardcore/encodings.go:86
guardcore/encodings.go:136
guardcore/encodings.go:187
guardcore/encodings.go:222
guardcore/encodings.go:321

# engine.go
# 160: findAllMatches stale-match guard (same regexp2 monotonic guarantee
#     as base64decode.go:54).
# 173: zero-advance guard. m.Index >= pos and zero-length matches already
#     advance (m.Length == 0 advances next by one), so next <= pos cannot
#     hold.
# 188: findFirstAt post-clamp guard. Every caller passes start < t.n, so
#     after clamping ceiling to len(rs), start < ceiling holds.
guardcore/engine.go:160
guardcore/engine.go:173
guardcore/engine.go:188

# fileupload.go
# 87: fileUploadIsDoubleExtension no-dot guard. A benign-terminal match
#     implies a literal '.' in the subject, so lastIndexOfRune('.') cannot
#     return -1.
guardcore/fileupload.go:87

# geoip.go
# 301: Refresh post-download stat guard. A nil download error means
#     writeDatabaseAtomically just wrote m.DBPath; os.Stat on the file
#     written moments before cannot fail in-process.
# 364: downloadDatabase post-loop return. The loop returns inside the body
#     on the final attempt (attempt == downloadRetries-1), so the loop can
#     never complete normally.
guardcore/geoip.go:301
guardcore/geoip.go:364

# jsonwalk.go
# 84: decodeJSONValue non-string object key. encoding/json only produces
#     string tokens for object keys, so the not-a-string branch is
#     unreachable.
guardcore/jsonwalk.go:84

# logging.go
# 128: redactPairsDepth submatch guard. The regex re-matches its own match
#     and all three groups are mandatory, so len(parts) == 4 always.
guardcore/logging.go:128

# matchers.go
# 163: ldapNullByteAttrFinditer overlap guard. findAllMatches yields
#     ordered, non-overlapping tail matches and lastEnd equals the previous
#     tail's end, so starPos >= lastEnd always.
# 216: quoteSpliceFinditer anchor-miss fallback. Once the scanner verified
#     the word-run, quote-run and trailing word char, quoteSpliceCandidate
#     (\w+(?:['"]+\w+){1,10}) always matches at w, so the else branch is
#     defensive.
guardcore/matchers.go:163
guardcore/matchers.go:216

# multipartscan.go
# 144: payloadSlice nil-start guard. The only call site passes a
#     payloadStart set by the blank-line or colonless-line transition, so
#     payloadStart >= 0 always.
# 157: payloadSlice negative-end clamp. The CR strip only runs when
#     end > payloadStart, so end >= payloadStart is an invariant and the
#     clamp is defensive.
guardcore/multipartscan.go:144
guardcore/multipartscan.go:157

# pipeline.go
# 1026: Execute rebuild-error branch. rebuildIfStale has no error return
#     path (the rebuild function returns checks only), so err != nil is
#     defensive.
# 1104, 1107, 1109, 1113, 1115, 1117, 1119: handleRebuildError body. The
#     function is only reachable from the defensive 1026 branch above.
# 1231: buildChecks nil-build fallback. Every spec in the table defines
#     build, so spec.build == nil cannot hold.
guardcore/pipeline.go:1026
guardcore/pipeline.go:1104
guardcore/pipeline.go:1107
guardcore/pipeline.go:1109
guardcore/pipeline.go:1113
guardcore/pipeline.go:1115
guardcore/pipeline.go:1117
guardcore/pipeline.go:1119
guardcore/pipeline.go:1231

# redis.go
# 274: RecordSlidingWindowHit rand guard. crypto/rand.Read cannot fail on
#     the supported platforms, so the error branch is defensive.
guardcore/redis.go:274

# registry.go
# 24: init compile-failure skip. Every patternTable entry compiles (the
#     detection suite pins the full table), so the continue is defensive.
# 279: safeFindAll stale-match guard (same regexp2 monotonic guarantee as
#     engine.go:160).
# 294: safeFindAll zero-advance guard (same proof as engine.go:173).
guardcore/registry.go:24
guardcore/registry.go:279
guardcore/registry.go:294

# semantic.go
# 313: codeInjectionRisk clamp. The maximum possible score is
#     0.2 + 0.2 + 0.1 + 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.8 < 1.0, so risk > 1.0 cannot hold.
guardcore/semantic.go:313

# templates.go
# 111: templateFrame compile guard. The regex is built by quoting the four
#     fixed opener/closer pairs into a literal class expression, which
#     compileRE cannot reject.
guardcore/templates.go:111
